# Commits a published build must contain, by hash, with what they fixed.
# release.yml's `which` job checks that the built commit has each as an
# ancestor, for every [release] and [publish], prerelease or full. Add a line
# when a fix lands that no release may go out without; never remove one.
#
#   commit | what it fixed
#
956af4a|TM-1: Ubuntu's security updates were silently never installed (os-release name)
6917bde|staging "cannot-measure": ntfsresize's answer was dropped on every real volume
54b783b|aurwl: subsurfaces composited into the window (Firefox was blank)
e1c8015|grub.cfg.in: the Windows start line carries lockdown=integrity too
76d89b9|aurfirst: "Start AurOS from now on" was refused on a real install (efivarfs)
7381d67|aurwl: clicks landed 20% off in GTK4 windows; the store's Install button never worked
f38af6f|the Install label was unreadable (text on the accent)
c74a440|signtest: its tree copy lacked docs/legal/notices, so tests / unit was red on every build before it
afc82b8|release.yml publish: checkout ran after the download and deleted the installer, so no build before it can be published
2f7ab0b|aurwl: a slow program's answers to its configures were refused, and its second window died
e80590e|aurwl: the Wayland clipboard was served to every X program at all times (review W01/W05/W09/W19)
402273f|the screen went dark in a VLC film or a Zoom call (no ScreenSaver inhibit); "Bigger text" never reached X programs
63e1017a|same-boot installation preserves kernel hardening and rejects Windows environment kernel-argument injection
